objectives.title: Data Extraction Format
objectives.description: The contract contains provisions regarding the format of exported personal data.
criteria: Provisions specifying commonly used data formats.

objectives.title: Unimpeded Data Transmission
objectives.description: The contract contains provisions addressing data transmission to alternative providers.
criteria: Provisions prohibiting provider hindrance during data transfers.
Provisions supporting direct controller-to-controller transmission mechanisms.
Provisions defining technical feasibility thresholds for transmission.

objectives.title: Portability Right Limitations
objectives.description: The contract contains provisions addressing limitations and exclusions on the exercise of the data portability right.
criteria: Provisions clarifying that the portability right is exercised without prejudice to the right to erasure under Article 17.
Provisions excluding the portability right for processing necessary for a task carried out in the public interest or in the exercise of official authority vested in the controller.
Provisions ensuring the exercise of the portability right does not adversely affect the rights and freedoms of third parties.
